title: Python: B.3.3 Queue Latency Measurement oracle
description:
queue_stats: packets_queued/dropped_deadline/dropped_full, max_latency_ms,
avg_latency_ms. Expose via /status/queues CoAP.

## MUST/SHALL Checklist

The spec section uses no explicit RFC 2119 keywords. Implicit requirements extracted:

- [ ] Track time-in-queue (latency), not just queue depth (spec line 138)
- [ ] queue_stats structure with fields:
  - [ ] packets_queued: Total packets pushed to queue
  - [ ] packets_dropped_deadline: Packets dropped due to deadline expiry
  - [ ] packets_dropped_full: Packets rejected when queue full
  - [ ] max_latency_ms: Worst-case queue time (maximum observed)
  - [ ] avg_latency_ms: Smoothed average queue latency
- [ ] Expose statistics via /status/queues CoAP resource for diagnostics (spec line 151)

## Implementation Status

Python: TxQueueStats in python/src/lichen/link/tx_queue.py (lines 174-195)
already implements all required fields plus:
- packets_dropped_preempt (extension: tracks priority evictions)
- packets_transmitted (extension: tracks successful completions)

The /status/queues CoAP endpoint exposure is not yet implemented.
